text: 在硅谷领袖抱怨美国近期为放缓尖端AI系统发布而采取的措施过于随意后，特朗普政府正在考虑一项计划，拟在业界的参与下，设立一个独立监管机构来审查人工智能模型的安全性。据知情人士透露，财政部长斯科特·贝森特协助制定了该提案。该提案将创建一个向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）汇报的独立AI监管机构，其模式类似于金融业监管局（FINRA）。该计划目前正由白宫幕僚长Susie Wiles进行审查。（彭博）
text_en: Following complaints from Silicon Valley leaders that US efforts to slow the release of advanced AI systems have been too arbitrary, the Trump administration is considering a plan to create an independent regulatory agency, with industry input, to review AI model safety. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has helped draft the proposal, which would establish an independent AI regulator reporting to the SEC, modeled on FINRA. The plan is currently under review by White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (Bloomberg).
